# the submitted recursion (also known as `TryStart` / `TryEnd`)
#
# Regenerate with:  python -m tools.make_traces
# Do not edit by hand: tests/test_docs_traces.py compares this file with a
# fresh run of the code it shows.

## the *archived* recursion, traced by patching the module at run time

TryStart and TryEnd are looked up in the module's globals on every call, so
replacing those two names with wrappers intercepts the recursion without
editing a line of the submission.  Note the empty TryEnd frames at
end == n: the scan always takes one step past the last character.

`-- TryStart(start=0, longest=0)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
    |-- TryEnd(start=0, end=0, freq='[]', distinct=0)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
    |   `-- TryEnd(start=0, end=1, freq='[1]', distinct=1)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
    |       `-- TryEnd(start=0, end=2, freq='[2]', distinct=1)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
    |           `-- TryEnd(start=0, end=3, freq='[2, 1]', distinct=2)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
    |               `-- TryEnd(start=0, end=4, freq='[2, 2]', distinct=2)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
    `-- TryStart(start=1, longest=4)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
        |-- TryEnd(start=1, end=1, freq='[]', distinct=0)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
        |   `-- TryEnd(start=1, end=2, freq='[1]', distinct=1)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
        |       `-- TryEnd(start=1, end=3, freq='[1, 1]', distinct=2)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
        |           `-- TryEnd(start=1, end=4, freq='[1, 2]', distinct=2)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
        `-- TryStart(start=2, longest=4)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
            |-- TryEnd(start=2, end=2, freq='[]', distinct=0)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
            |   `-- TryEnd(start=2, end=3, freq='[1]', distinct=1)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
            |       `-- TryEnd(start=2, end=4, freq='[2]', distinct=1)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
            `-- TryStart(start=3, longest=4)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
                |-- TryEnd(start=3, end=3, freq='[]', distinct=0)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
                |   `-- TryEnd(start=3, end=4, freq='[1]', distinct=1)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
                `-- TryStart(start=4, longest=4)  -> [4, ['aabb']]

## the same tree for 'aabbb'

The freq column lists the non-zero counts in alphabet order as they stand
*on entry* to the call -- the call then folds S[end] into them.  So the
frame at end=3 (freq [2, 1], the window 'aab') is the one that adds the
second 'b' and records 'aabb'; the frame below it already holds [2, 2].

The scan carries on to end=5, where the whole string 'aabbb' has counts 2
and 3 and is not balanced -- but the answer (4, ['aabb']) stays on the
books.  The recursive submission is *right* here.  The loop submission,
given exactly the same string, answers (0, []): see balanced-bug-table.txt.

`-- TryStart(start=0, longest=0)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
    |-- TryEnd(start=0, end=0, freq='[]', distinct=0)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
    |   `-- TryEnd(start=0, end=1, freq='[1]', distinct=1)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
    |       `-- TryEnd(start=0, end=2, freq='[2]', distinct=1)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
    |           `-- TryEnd(start=0, end=3, freq='[2, 1]', distinct=2)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
    |               `-- TryEnd(start=0, end=4, freq='[2, 2]', distinct=2)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
    |                   `-- TryEnd(start=0, end=5, freq='[2, 3]', distinct=2)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
    `-- TryStart(start=1, longest=4)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
        |-- TryEnd(start=1, end=1, freq='[]', distinct=0)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
        |   `-- TryEnd(start=1, end=2, freq='[1]', distinct=1)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
        |       `-- TryEnd(start=1, end=3, freq='[1, 1]', distinct=2)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
        |           `-- TryEnd(start=1, end=4, freq='[1, 2]', distinct=2)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
        |               `-- TryEnd(start=1, end=5, freq='[1, 3]', distinct=2)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
        `-- TryStart(start=2, longest=4)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
            |-- TryEnd(start=2, end=2, freq='[]', distinct=0)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
            |   `-- TryEnd(start=2, end=3, freq='[1]', distinct=1)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
            |       `-- TryEnd(start=2, end=4, freq='[2]', distinct=1)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
            |           `-- TryEnd(start=2, end=5, freq='[3]', distinct=1)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
            `-- TryStart(start=3, longest=4)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
                |-- TryEnd(start=3, end=3, freq='[]', distinct=0)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
                |   `-- TryEnd(start=3, end=4, freq='[1]', distinct=1)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
                |       `-- TryEnd(start=3, end=5, freq='[2]', distinct=1)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
                `-- TryStart(start=4, longest=4)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
                    |-- TryEnd(start=4, end=4, freq='[]', distinct=0)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
                    |   `-- TryEnd(start=4, end=5, freq='[1]', distinct=1)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
                    `-- TryStart(start=5, longest=4)  -> [4, ['aabb']]
